physicalEvidence.status: Current same-university collaborative learned Go2 navigation; shared physical 20
physicalEvidence.summary: Full February 2026 TIC-VLA study combines delayed VLM semantic reasoning with a fast learned action policy trained through imitation and RL. It executes navigation on a real Unitree Go2 in four indoor/outdoor tasks, five trials each. The reported setup includes RTX 4060 laptop and onboard Orin NX, with remote A6000 for larger baselines. Learned navigation produces motion commands; this is not evidence of newly trained joint-level locomotion. Tang is a current UCLA coauthor, but the published apparatus is a UCLA Mobility collaboration, not independently verified exclusive TAMS equipment.

shortVisit.summary: The full live TAMS join page explicitly welcomes inquiries from master’s/undergraduate applicants not affiliated with UCLA. If fit is strong, it can explore in-person or remote collaboration. Summer internship applicants, internal or external, should submit its form by March 1 of the desired year. This is a standing annual instruction, not a dated announcement guaranteeing summer 2027 places, funding, duration or acceptance. Active PhD and master’s supervision is verified on the lab roster.
